title: 潘功胜：中国增长模式转向创新驱动，高科技发展提供韧性
speaker: Pan Gongsheng

segments.en: China's company are investing a lot in R&D and helping the integration of research with industry. Our growth model shifted from the production elements to innovation and from manufacturing to high-tech development and emerging technologies.
segments.zh: 中国企业大力投入研发，推动产学研融合。增长模式从生产要素转向创新，从制造转向高科技和新兴技术。

segments.en: This sustainable development of technology offers us resilience and long-term growth.
segments.zh: 这种可持续的技术发展为我们提供了韧性和长期增长。

segments.en: Starting from this year, China will focus on more high-tech development through the master plan and the mid-term check and the end-term targets and China is trying to ensure the high-quality
segments.zh: 从今年开始，中国将通过总体规划、中期检查和终期目标，聚焦高科技发展，努力确保高质量。
